timing_scope: Same-artifact narrow-QK, final-query/output-liveness, paired-GDN, fused-PV, compact-MoE and adaptive-OUT stack with five profile options and marker filtering disabled. Linear core stages are disjoint internally; preceding projections are separate. Nine full-query CK completed phases are nested in full attention; terminal-query and decode calls are outside this CK profile; its probability phase includes native PV and its approximate-PV phase is only an empty completion boundary; first lazy EXP initialization is outside the internal CK profile but remains included in outer full-attention and first-callback TTFT. Routed and shared MoE overlap. Dense correction excludes the matrix producer; coarse OUT includes preparation, producer, replay and conversion. Device-event negative/nonfinite values are preserved as invalid and excluded from totals. Instrumentation overhead remains; this is no retained-performance result.
